title: Digit to number
description:
The character `'7'` is not the number 7: its code is 55. Write `int digitValue(char digit)` that turns a digit character into the number it shows.

```cpp
digitValue('7')   // 7
digitValue('0')   // 0
```

The digit characters `'0'` to `'9'` sit next to each other in the code table, in order.
hints: `'7'` is 55 and `'0'` is 48. What do you get if you subtract one from the other?
